build_metadata_service: build a MetadataService instance to manage package metadata in a DynamoDB table
get_package_metadata: get package metadata from DynamoDB by package name and version using MetadataService
put_package_metadata: put package metadata into DynamoDB using MetadataService and a PackageMetadata object
build_dynamodb_key: build a DynamoDB key string from package name and version using the _build_key method
review_MetadataService: review the MetadataService class and its DynamoDB integration for package metadata management
